subject: 🤖 Nous Hermes Agent Lives in Teams Now, MIT Licensed
notes: No funding rounds, acquisitions, IPOs or funds in this issue. Sponsor blocks (incident.io, Google Cloud TPUs, Chalk) and event promos ignored.

stories.headline: Google releases Gemini 4 Neon: 1M context, $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output
stories.quote: Google releases Gemini 4 Neon with 1M context at $3 per million tokens
stories.description: Gemini 4 Neon model, between Google's mid-tier and top-tier models

facts.text: Gemini 4 Neon price: $3 per million input tokens, $15 per million output tokens; available via the Gemini API or AI Studio.
facts.quote: Pricing is $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output. You can hit it right now via the Gemini API or AI Studio using model ID

facts.text: Stated as 32% cheaper per task than Gemini 4 Carbon at the default setting (measured per task; the issue does not say who measured it).
Four thinking levels to trade cost against intelligence per task.
facts.quote: Four thinking levels (low, medium, high, xhigh), letting you dial cost vs. intelligence per task

facts.text: Reported 58.6 on the Coding Agent Index (ranked #1) and 65.4% vs 58.1% for Claude Opus 5.5 on CursorBench.
facts.quote: (58.6), beating Claude Opus 5.5 on CursorBench 65.4% vs 58.1%

stories.headline: OpenAI ships GPT-Live-1.1 to the API; standby mode prices idle call time at $0.02 per minute instead of $0.05
stories.quote: OpenAI ships GPT-Live-1.1 to API with standby mode cutting idle costs 60%
stories.description: GPT-Live-1.1 voice model, now available in the API

facts.text: In standby mode the call stays open at $0.02 per minute.
Usual rate is $0.05 per minute; the issue describes the difference as a 60% drop in idle costs.
facts.quote: instead of the usual $0.05. That's a 60% drop in idle costs.

facts.text: Standby is triggered by a silence timeout of 5 to 60 seconds.
facts.quote: Voice calls cost money even when nobody is talking. Standby solves that. Set a silence timeout between 5 and 60 seconds. When the user goes quiet, the model pauses but the call stays open at

facts.text: Standby works on both GPT-Live-1 and GPT-Live-1.1.
facts.quote: Standby works on both GPT-Live-1 and GPT-Live-1.1

stories.headline: Nous Research releases Hermes Enterprise, bringing its Hermes agent to Microsoft Teams and Azure, MIT licensed
stories.quote: Nous Research brings its Hermes agent to Microsoft Teams and Azure
stories.description: Open-source Hermes AI agent for enterprise use inside Teams

facts.text: Agent tasks can run in isolated Azure Container Apps sandboxes.
Can be deployed inside a company's own Azure tenant.
facts.quote: Deploy the whole thing inside your own Azure tenant if your company has strict data rules

facts.text: Hermes Desktop is available from the Microsoft Store for Windows.
facts.quote: Download Hermes Desktop from the Microsoft Store for Windows
